text: By 2030, we commit to reducing our absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 50% against our 2020 baseline. This target has been validated by the Science Based Targets initiative.
Our total energy consumption decreased by 4.1% year over year, reflecting efficiency upgrades completed across three manufacturing sites during the reporting period.
We pledge to achieve net-zero emissions across our full value chain by 2040. As an interim milestone, 60% of our electricity will come from renewable sources by 2027.
The company will ensure that 100% of its palm oil is certified sustainable by the end of the next fiscal year, and independent audits will verify supplier compliance.
Sustainability remains a core value that informs how we operate and engage with our stakeholders around the world every single day.
We aim to increase the representation of women in senior leadership to 40% by 2028. Current representation stands at 31%, up from 27% two years ago.
Our operations will send zero waste to landfill by 2026. To date, five of our twelve facilities have reached this milestone and diverted 96% of waste through recycling and composting.
We will invest 200 million in employee reskilling programs over the coming three years to prepare our workforce for the transition to low-carbon operations.
This year we launched a new supplier code of conduct and are committed to phasing out single-use plastics from our packaging as soon as viable alternatives can be identified.
The board has approved a policy to link 15% of executive compensation to the achievement of our published ESG targets, effective from the current fiscal year.
